interpretation.dose: Removing 95% of the mean separation is the first tested grid point with mean oriented linear AUC <= 0.52; 90% remains above threshold.
interpretation.mass: Moving 95% of protected-group samples by the full -delta_mu displacement is the first tested grid point with mean oriented linear AUC <= 0.52; 90% remains above threshold.
interpretation.theoretical_endpoint: At dose=1 or mass=1 the population mean difference induced by the constructed mean-shift component is zero; empirical AUC remains slightly above 0.5 because of finite-sample estimation/noise.
interpretation.practical_conclusion: The M2 critical mass is approximately 0.95 of the mean-shift mass on the tested 5% grid, not 1.0 in the finite-sample detection criterion.
interpretation.scope: This closes the controlled mean-separation question only; it does not imply complete protected-information removal when covariance/nonlinear structure is present.
